summary: Master Finance Business Partnering. Learn to influence strategy, drive commercial value, and lead finance transformation. Advanced 5-day course.
lede: Finance business partnering connects financial analysis with operational decision-making for experienced finance professionals supporting business leaders. The course covers analytical frameworks for assessing business risks and value drivers, alongside rolling forecasts and strategic KPI dashboards. Learners also practice communicating financial insights, influencing stakeholders, and planning finance transformation.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for experienced finance professionals who are moving into or currently occupy roles that require high-level strategic collaboration and commercial decision support.
modules: Strategic Context of Finance Business Partnering
Advanced Analytical Frameworks for Decision Support
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 5-7 years of experience in a finance or accounting role, with a solid understanding of financial statements and budgeting processes. Prior experience in a management or supervisory capacity is highly recommended. No programming knowledge is required, though familiarity with advanced Excel functions is expected.
